author: Tavi88
quote: Es el juego perfecto, si alguna vez quisieras experimentar la versión de Luke Skywalker de Nintendo ese es Fox McCloud. Con la tecnología de ahora se puede visualizar lo que el equipo de Star Fox trato de compartirnos en los 90s. En fin es un juego que tienes que tiene la mejor replay value, una historia y lore interesante, un multiplayer ultra competitivo, y una presentación AAA.

author: Tavi88
quote: This is the best tennis game ever made by Nintendo and honestly, by any publisher. It perfectly balances being fun and family-friendly while still offering a surprisingly deep competitive side. Matches can feel just as intense as a game of FIFA or even like a fighting game when things get really close. But at the end of the day, it’s tennis ! and tennis is always fun!! The game is packed with replayability, with tons of unlockable characters and courts that keep you coming back for more. On top of that, it delivers the best online experience on the Switch 2 so far. Smooth, addictive, and incredibly FUN this game is simply superb..!!

author: Tavi88
quote: Metroid Prime 4 is the essence of Metroid Prime in all its glory. From the very first moment, it’s clear that Nintendo understood exactly what made the original trilogy special—and somehow elevated it even further. The visuals are stunning, with environments so finely detailed they rival, and in some areas even surpass, what we saw in Halo Infinite. Every biome feels handcrafted, alive, and **** of the biggest surprises is the NPCs. Instead of being intrusive or annoying, they’re charming, minimal, and perfectly integrated into the world. They appear just enough to add flavor without ever breaking that iconic Metroid sense of **** desert zone—where you ride the motorcycle—is brilliant. It feels like the Great Sea in Wind Waker: a vast, open space with secrets to uncover, small challenges scattered around, and a sense of calm exploration that’s genuinely enjoyable. It’s a bold addition that fits surprisingly well into the Prime **** music is, of course, perfect. Metroid has always excelled at creating soundscapes of mystery and discovery, and Prime 4 continues that legacy flawlessly. Every track enhances the feeling of stepping into the unknown.Performance is outstanding. The gameplay feels frame-perfect whether you’re playing at 60fps or pushing it to 120fps. Controls are responsive, shooting is tight, and movement feels better than ever.Nintendo absolutely outdid themselves with this one. Metroid Prime 4 is a must-play—whether you’re a veteran of the series or stepping into Samus’s world for the very first time.

author: Tavi88
quote:
After spending hours behind the wheel, I can say it without hesitation: Mario Kart World is the best Mario Kart I’ve ever played. It even surpasses classics like Mario Kart DS, which I used to consider unbeatable. This new entry keeps the core magic of the series, but adds just the right amount of innovation to become a true hit that will define this **** character selection is massive (my personal favorite is the penguin!), and the tracks are now extended and interconnected in a way that makes each race feel like a continuous, epic adventure. Everything flows, everything feels **** let’s talk about the Knock-Out Tour mode — a brilliant mix between battle royale and death race. It’s a high-stakes elimination race where surviving each lap is a thrill on its own. It’s intense, addictive, and one of the most exciting features ever added to the **** here’s the best part: you don’t need to be a long-time fan to enjoy it. Mario Kart World is fun, accessible, and thrilling for everyone — whether you're a veteran or just jumping in for the first time.Bottom line? It’s a gem. 

Nintendo did it again.

author: Tavi88
quote:
Super Mario Maker is a dream come true. This is the video game that if my Dad, my older brother and I had gotten 23 years ago, we would have been playing for all of the weekends. Here is a list of the pros and cons to back up my review.

The pros:
-You can make your own levels.
-You can choose from four different Mario games.
-You can upload the your levels to the Internet(only if you finish it).
-Community is extremely friendly.
-It has some of the biggest challenges I've ever tried in my gamer life (go and watch Pangapae videos at youtube)
-Makes your imagination part of the brain to actually work.
-Infinite levels to play.
-Difficulty level modes is well divided: Easy, Medium and Expert.
-It has checkpoints(after the last update)

Cons:

- Non.

In conclusion, if you ever liked Mario games and want a tool to develop creation habits, this is the game for you.
